$signalId..write: auth != null && auth.token.roomMember == true && newData.child('senderId').val() == auth.uid
$signalId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['senderId', 'senderName', 'kind', 'createdAt']) && newData.child('senderName').isString() && newData.child('senderName').val().length <= 30 && (newData.child('kind').val() == 'kangen' || newData.child('kind').val() == 'peluk' || newData.child('kind').val() == 'daisy') && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber()
